name: Avant Staked USD
oneLiner: savUSD is Avant's yield-bearing wrapper of avUSD; share price compounds with delta-neutral strategy yield, exits inherit avUSD's USDC redemption.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: READY_FOR_REPLAY: the official registry identifies Avalanche 0x06d47f3fb376649c3a9dafe069b3d6e35572219e as native Staked avUSD. At Avalanche block 90341316, its verified non-proxy StakedAvUSDV2 runtime had owner() 0xd4d23209aaE8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb, which held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE was administered by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. The verified source lets a blacklist manager assign FULL_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE through addToBlacklist(), blocks a fully restricted holder's transfers, transferFrom, deposits, and withdrawals in _update/_deposit/_withdraw, and lets DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE burn or redirect that holder's entire balance with redistributeLockedAmount(). Because the current default admin can grant itself BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE, this is an active direct holder-control path, so the review is Yes. The official registry labels the other tracked savUSD contracts Bridged. This direct finding is limited to the native Avalanche deployment and does not assert that any bridged representation shares its blacklist, restriction, or seizure code; route-specific bridge controls remain separately scoped bridge-risk evidence. Avant's Terms govern interface/protocol access but do not replace the on-chain finding; the transparency page is available, and Archive.org returned no snapshot for the reviewed contract registry or Terms URLs.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

collateral: avUSD staked into Avant's savings vault as the yield-bearing Senior Tranche; yield is sourced from Avant's actively managed delta-neutral / market-neutral strategies (basis trades, lending-rate arbitrage, yield trading), with portfolio NAV calculated weekly by independent valuation provider Pennyworks. Losses are absorbed first by the avUSD Reserve Fund and then by the avUSDx Junior Tranche before reaching savUSD
pegMechanism: Stake avUSD to receive savUSD; the savUSD/avUSD exchange rate compounds as strategy yield accrues. Unstaking savUSD to avUSD has a 1-day cooldown during which no yield is earned; the final USDC exit inherits Avant's 1:1 avUSD redemption process

proofOfReserves.provider: Pennyworks (weekly NAV) + published on-chain Reserve Fund / strategy wallets

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: savUSD is an avUSD variant whose supported cross-chain deployments use Chainlink CCIP Burn & Mint pools as the primary route, with LayerZero OFT/OFT-adapter infrastructure for Movement and Avalanche. Because CCIP and LayerZero are third-party messaging bridges, Pharos keeps the route scored as external lock/mint exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: savUSD (StakedAvUSDV2) is Avant's staked wrapper of avUSD; shares are minted only via deposit() — no privileged mint function. Not upgradeable (proxiableUUID reverts, no EIP-1967 slots). DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0xd4d23209... confirmed on Avalanche and Ethereum deployments.

controls.label: savUSD savings vault (StakedAvUSDV2, non-upgradeable)
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 87752599: owner() = 0xd4d23209aae8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, owner) = true; proxiableUUID() reverts; EIP-1967 proxy admin and impl slots = zero (not an upgradeable proxy). StakedAvUSDV2 ABI (Routescan verified): deposit-only minting, no privileged mint(). Ethereum deployment 0xb8d89678... confirms same EOA owner. Deployer eth_getCode = 0x (EOA). No upgrade surface exists on the wrapper.

controls.label: Inherited avUSD issuer mint authority
controls.evidence: Underlying avUSD is minted 1:1 against USDC via Avant's AvantMintingV2 contract, with privileged operations behind MPC custody (Fireblocks/Fordefi), a policy engine, and RBAC. savUSD inherits this concentrated-admin posture from the parent.

review.evidence: At Avalanche block 87752599 and Ethereum block 25295219: savUSD (StakedAvUSDV2) is not upgradeable on any deployment. DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0xd4d23209aae8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb confirmed on Avalanche and Ethereum. Minting is deposit-only (ERC-4626 share accounting). Wrapper mint surface fully confirmed; parent avUSD mint path tracked separately.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: savUSD inherits avUSD's synthetic-delta-neutral mechanism; its strategy-vault classification captures the senior-tranche yield and loss ordering rather than a distinct mechanism archetype.
